timeline.text: On October 14th, YouTube ran for 80 straight minutes with zero chores finished that day.
The gate used to default open whenever nobody had started their tasks — nobody had to earn it.
Now it defaults locked, and a parent needs a real way in.
They scan a QR code, sign in with their Google account, then confirm with WebAuthn — their phone's own fingerprint check.
One scan now buys exactly 30 minutes of access.
